verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents 'Code Evaluators' for running deterministic checks as part of its evaluation offering, alongside SDK-based scoring (Scores via API/SDK) and worked examples (hallucination detection, RAG faithfulness) implementing custom evaluator functions via the Python SDK. This directly supports ML engineers writing custom code-based scorers integrated into experiments and production trace scoring. Missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on confirmation of writing custom scorers, and no deeper docs excerpt showing the actual scorer API/interface.
